lines: A bench facing the Museum doors. A brass plate on the back: THE FRIENDS OF THE CASTLE MUSEUM, FOR THOSE WHO COME EARLY.
The doors open at ten. Somebody has worn the paint off the end nearest them.
You sit. Nobody else comes. At ten there is a sound of bolts behind the doors, and then nothing.
A bench facing the Museum doors. They are open. Nobody is on the bench, and nobody has been.
